title: Preliminary study on molecular mechanism of COVID-19 intervention by Polygonum cuspidatum through computer bioinformatics.
authors: Liu, Tao; Han, Rui; Yan, Yiqi
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学和分子对接研究虎杖干预COVID-19的机制，虽涉及蛋白-小分子对接，但核心是药物靶点与通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法创新。
abstract: To explore the mechanism of action of Polygonum cuspidatum in intervening in coronavirus disease 2019 using a network pharmacology approach and to preliminarily elucidate its mechanism. The active ingredients and action targets of P cuspidatum were classified and summarized using computer virtual technology and molecular informatics methods. The active ingredients and relevant target information of P cuspidatum were identified using the TCM Systematic Pharmacology Database and Analysis Platform, the TCM Integrated Pharmacology Research Platform v2.0, and the SwissTarget database. The GENECARDS database was used to search for COVID-19 targets. The STRING database was analyzed and combined with Cytoscape 3.7.1 software to construct a protein interaction network map to screen the core targets. Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes pathway enrichment analysis was then performed. The core compound, polydatin, was selected and the core targets were analyzed by computer virtual docking using software such as discovery studio autodock tool. In vitro cell models were constructed to experimentally validate the activity of the core compound, polydatin. By computer screening, we identified 9 active ingredients and their corresponding 286 targets from P cuspidatum. A search of the GENECARDS database for COVID-19 yielded 303 core targets. By mapping the active ingredient targets to the disease targets, 27 overlapping targets could be extracted as potential targets for the treatment of COVID-19 with P cuspidatum. In addition, the enrichment analysis of Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes pathway on core targets showed that the coronavirus disease, MAPK signaling pathway, NF kappa B signaling pathway, and other signaling pathways were highly enriched. Combined with the degree-high target analysis in the protein interaction network, it was found to be mainly concentrated in the NF-kappaB (NF-kappaB) signaling pathway, indicating that the NF-kappaB signaling pathway may be an important pathway for P cuspidatum intervention. In vitro assays showed no effect of 0.1 to 10 muM polydatin on cell viability, but an inhibitory effect on the transcriptional activity of NF-kappaB-RE. Molecular docking showed stable covalent bonding of polydatin molecules with Il-1beta protein at residue leu-26, TNF protein ser-60, residue gly-121, and residue ile-258 of ICAM-1 protein, indicating a stable docking result. The treatment of COVID-19 with P cuspidatum is characterized by multi-component, multi-target, and multi-pathway, which can exert a complex network of regulatory effects through the interaction between different targets, providing a new idea and basis for further exploration of the mechanism of action of P cuspidatum in the treatment of COVID-19.
abstract_zh: 旨在通过网络药理学方法探讨虎杖干预新型冠状病毒病的作用机制，并初步阐明其作用机理。采用计算机虚拟技术和分子信息学方法，对虎杖的活性成分及作用靶点进行分类和归纳。利用中药系统药理学数据库与分析平台、中药综合药理学研究平台v2.0及SwissTarget数据库，鉴定虎杖的活性成分及相关靶点信息。使用GENECARDS数据库检索COVID-19相关靶点。通过STRING数据库分析并结合Cytoscape 3.7.1软件构建蛋白质相互作用网络图，以筛选核心靶点。随后进行京都基因与基因组百科全书通路富集分析。选取核心化合物虎杖苷，并利用discovery studio autodock tool等软件对核心靶点进行计算机虚拟对接分析。构建体外细胞模型，实验验证核心化合物虎杖苷的活性。通过计算机筛选，从虎杖中鉴定出9个活性成分及其对应的286个靶点。GENECARDS数据库检索COVID-19得到303个核心靶点。将活性成分靶点与疾病靶点映射后，提取出27个重叠靶点作为虎杖治疗COVID-19的潜在靶点。此外，对核心靶点进行京都基因与基因组百科全书通路富集分析显示，冠状病毒病、MAPK信号通路、NF kappa B信号通路等信号通路高度富集。结合蛋白质相互作用网络中的高度靶点分析，发现主要集中于NF-kappaB（NF-kappaB）信号通路，表明NF-kappaB信号通路可能是虎杖干预的重要通路。体外实验显示，0.1至10 μM虎杖苷对细胞活力无影响，但对NF-kappaB-RE的转录活性具有抑制作用。分子对接显示，虎杖苷分子与Il-1beta蛋白在残基leu-26、TNF蛋白ser-60、残基gly-121及ICAM-1蛋白残基ile-258处形成稳定共价键，表明对接结果稳定。虎杖治疗COVID-19具有多成分、多靶点、多通路的特点，可通过不同靶点间的相互作用发挥复杂的网络调控效应，为进一步探索虎杖治疗COVID-19的作用机制提供了新思路和依据。
